camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public ChangeVisibilityModel --region cn-hangzhou --MenuIds '54kqgoa****,pg1n135****' --DataPortalId '0d173abb53e84c8ca7495429163b****' --ShowOnlyWithAccess true --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the visibility of data portal menus and specifies whether the menus are visible only to authorized users
description_zh: 修改数据门户菜单的可见方式，是否仅授权可见
name: ChangeVisibilityModel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the leaf node menus in the data portal.

You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs can be modified at a time
parameters.help_zh:
数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为100
parameters.name: menu_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the menus are visible only to authorized users. Valid values:

true: The menus are visible only to authorized users.
false: The menus are visible to all users
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅授权可见。取值范围：

true：仅授权可见
false：都可见
parameters.name: show_only_with_access

Result.description_en: The number of menus that are successfully modified

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
